About this Event

Sound Bath & Yoga at The Japanese Tea Garden
Join Tenshi Health & Fitness for a morning of renewal and balance in the serene beauty of the Japanese Tea Garden.
This unique experience blends:
🌿 Restorative Yoga – gentle movement and mindful flow
🎶 Immersive Sound Bath – soothing vibrations to calm the mind and body
🌸 Japanese-Inspired Wellness – a harmony of strength and serenity, woven into every detail
At Tenshi Health & Fitness, we offer a holistic approach to wellness, uniting Personal Training, Small Group Classes, Yoga, Pilates, and restorative practices. Our philosophy is rooted in strength, balance, and mindfulness, drawing inspiration from Japanese culture to bring a calming and service forward experience for everyone.
Through this special collaboration with the Japanese Tea Garden, we invite you to experience the balanced fusion of movement, sound, and nature, while giving back to a San Antonio treasure.
